text: FAA guidance: reestablish the control link or discontinue flight when control is lost; there is no claim of a forever-hover mode. Autel EVO Max 4N manual: the Signal Lost actions include Return to Home, Hover, and Land, with behavior depending on the type and duration of link loss; if the link is restored within 10 seconds, control can return. Incident reports (unverified): accounts describe complete loss of control, attempts to use RTH failing, and the platform not recovered. Gap/Conflict: there is no verified evidence that the drone can hover forever after signal loss; manufacturer behavior is contingent on configured actions and timeouts, while unverified reports show loss of control with no recovery.
